title.en: O 2 2023 ED PRICE CONTROL MAXIMUM PRICES AND CHARGES ORDER

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《CAP-142-O-2-2023-ED-PRICE-CONTROL-MAXIMUM-PRICES-AND-CHARGES-ORDER.pdf》（6 页），本次切分 11 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Price Control (Maximum Prices and Charges) Order. Maximum prices and charges [S 54/2021]

The Price Controller hereby orders that the maximum prices and charges for the goods or classes of goods specified in the Schedule to which section 3B(1) applies shall be published on the website of the Department of Economic Planning and Statistics at http://www.deps.gov.bn or in such other manner as the Controller considers appropriate. 6 CAP. 142, O 2 Price Control SCHEDULE [S 54/2021] (paragraph 2)

GOODS OR CLASSES OF GOODS FIXED WITH MAXIMUM PRICES

AND CHARGES
Sugar (acquired and supplied by the Treasury Department, Ministry of Finance and Economy)
Formulated powdered milk (for infants to 6 years of age)
Cooking oils (canola, corn, palm, vegetables, sunflower and soya bean).
